name: Praveen Kumar Pedapapa
summary:
Having a total of 9 years of IT experience in software development, build, and deployment, I specialize in designing and developing scalable system and web-based applications using Java and J2EE technologies. My expertise includes Spring Boot, Microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, Spring Framework, and Hibernate for building robust and high-performance enterprise solutions..
Possess strong hands-on experience in front-end development using JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Angular, and React.js, building responsive, interactive, and user-friendly web applications with optimized performance and cross-browser compatibility.
Having good experience in development of applications using design patterns.
Extensive experience working with backend frameworks and technologies such as Spring, Spring Boot, Node.js, Microservices architecture, JPA, and Hibernate, building RESTful APIs and scalable distributed systems.
Strong database development experience with SQL, MySQL, and PostgreSQL, including writing optimized queries, stored procedures, indexing strategies, and database performance tuning.
Capable of working independently as well as collaboratively within cross-functional teams, demonstrating excellent analytical, technical, and communication skills.
A self-motivated and results-driven professional with a strong commitment to quality, continuous learning, and delivering high-impact software solutions aligned with business objectives.
